purpose: Photographic left and right side views for sleeve editing

images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image is the approved front/back photographic grey regular-fit short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt for a garment customization studio; preserve its fabric, fit, seams and neutral lighting. Create a NEW matching pair of true SIDE-ANGLE garment photographs for sleeve customization. Exactly two isolated garments in a 1536x1024 image, equal 768x1024 panels. LEFT PANEL: camera looks squarely at the wearer's LEFT OUTER SLEEVE, from a strict side profile with only a very narrow sliver of the front torso visible; front of garment points toward image left. RIGHT PANEL: matching view of the wearer's RIGHT OUTER SLEEVE, front points toward image right. These are opposite profiles, not front/back views. The outer surface of each sleeve must face the camera directly, be unobstructed, prominent and flat enough to place artwork, occupying the central part of each panel around x=384 relative to its own half. Entire garment including sleeve visible with generous clear margins; neckline y=80, hem about y=940. Sleeve hangs naturally straight down, no hands, no model, no mannequin visible, no hanger. For T-shirts show the full short sleeve cuff and a broad, clearly visible outer upper-arm surface; for hoodies show the full sleeve length from shoulder to ribbed cuff. Light grey cotton with subtle realistic weave and shallow folds, blank with no logo, no text, no design, no watermark. Orthographic commercial product photography with genuine transparent alpha around both garments, no solid background or outside shadow. Maintain realistic proportions; no angle that hides the sleeve.
